data.name: ServerControls_Name_Help
data.value: This is the name that will appear in the Community Servers list within Valheim.

data.name: ServerControls_Port_Help
data.value: The UDP port to run on (1–65535). Valheim also uses the next port up.

data.name: ServerControls_Password_Help
data.value: Your server must be protected with a password. The password must be at least 5 characters and must not contain the name of the server or the world that you're hosting.

data.name: ServerControls_OpenSaveFolder_Tip
data.value: Open the save data folder in your file manager

data.name: ServerControls_Public_Help
data.value:
If this box is checked, your server will show up in the Community Servers list within Valheim. If not, other players will need to "Join by IP" to connect to your game.
NOTE: It usually takes 1-2 minutes for your server to appear in the list in-game, but it can take up to 15 minutes, and rarely not show up at all. You can always "Join by IP" as a fallback.

data.name: ServerControls_Crossplay_Help
data.value:
Allow players on other platforms to join your game (Microsoft Store, Xbox, etc.)
You may need to provide other players an Invite Code, which appears in game and in the server logs.

data.name: AdvancedControls_ServerExe_Help
data.value:
The location of the Valheim Dedicated Server executable, usually "valheim_server.exe".
This field sets the path just for this profile. Leave this field empty if you do not want a profile-specific override. To set this path for all profiles, see File > Set Directories.

data.name: AdvancedControls_SaveData_Help
data.value:
The location of the save data for your Valheim server, including the "worlds" folder, admin lists, etc.
This field sets the path just for this profile. Leave this field empty if you do not want a profile-specific override. To set this path for all profiles, see File > Set Directories.

data.name: AdvancedControls_AutoStart_Help
data.value: Automatically start up this server when you open ValheimServerGUI. If you want to restart your server whenever you restart your computer, enable this setting, along with the corresponding setting under File > Preferences.

data.name: AdvancedControls_WriteLogs_Help
data.value: If enabled, this server's logs will be written to a daily rolling log file on disk. Logs older than 30 days will be deleted automatically.

data.name: AdvancedControls_AdditionalArgs_Help
data.value: Add any additional args you want to pass to the server run command here. These will be appended to the end of the command generated by ValheimServerGUI.

data.name: AdvancedControls_Backups_Help
data.value: Number of world data backups to maintain. One rolling backup is created on the short backup interval, and subsequent backups are created on the long backup interval.

data.name: AdvancedControls_SaveInterval_Help
data.value: How often the world is saved.

data.name: AdvancedControls_ShortBackup_Help
data.value: How often to create a rolling backup of the world save data.

data.name: AdvancedControls_LongBackup_Help
data.value: How often to create additional backups of the world save data. This interval must be longer than the short backup interval.

data.name: ServerDetails_ExternalIp_Help
data.value: This is the address that players from outside your home network will use to connect to your server. Give this address to your friends for standard online play.

data.name: ServerDetails_ExternalIp_CopyTip
data.value: Copy external IP address to clipboard

data.name: ServerDetails_InternalIp_Help
data.value: This is the address that players on your home network (connected to your router) can use to join your server. Give this address to your friends for LAN setups, or use it yourself if you're hosting your server on another machine on your home network (different from the one you're playing on).

data.name: ServerDetails_InternalIp_CopyTip
data.value: Copy internal IP address to clipboard

data.name: ServerDetails_LocalIp_Help
data.value:
Use this IP address to connect to your server if you're playing on the host machine. This will give you the fastest possible connection! (i.e. "the host advantage")
TIP: You can also connect to "localhost", which is a little easier than typing "127.0.0.1"

data.name: ServerDetails_LocalIp_CopyTip
data.value: Copy local IP address to clipboard

data.name: ServerDetails_InviteCode_Help
data.value: Invite codes are only available when Crossplay is enabled and change each time the server is restarted. Players on any platform can connect to your server with an invite code instead of an IP address.

data.name: ServerDetails_TroubleConnecting
data.value: Trouble connecting? See Help > Port Forwarding.

data.name: ServerDetails_AvgWorldSave_Help
data.value: The average amount of time it has taken to save your game world, over the past 10 saves.

data.name: Players_UsePermittedList_Help

data.name: Preferences_CheckForUpdates_Help
data.value:
If enabled, ValheimServerGUI will check for updates automatically when the app starts up, and again every 24 hours.
If disabled, you can check for updates anytime from Help > Check for updates.

data.name: Preferences_StartWithOs_Help
data.value: To start your server(s) on system startup, enable this setting along with "Start this server with ValheimServerGUI" under Advanced Controls for each server.

data.name: Preferences_StartMinimized_Help
data.value: Enable this setting to minimize VSG to the system tray when it starts up.

data.name: Preferences_SaveOnStart_Label
data.value: Auto save profile when starting server

data.name: Preferences_SaveOnStart_Help
data.value: If enabled, any changes you made to your server profile will be saved when you click Start Server. Otherwise, you must manually save changes with File > Save.

data.name: Preferences_WriteAppLogs_Help
data.value:
If enabled, any application logs from ValheimServerGUI will be written to a daily rolling log file on disk. Logs older than 30 days will be deleted automatically.
Note: this setting does not affect your server's logs. You can toggle server logs under the Advanced Controls tab for each server profile.

data.name: Preferences_ValidatePassword_Help
data.value:
Valheim Dedicated Server will not start if certain password requirements aren't met, and VSG enforces these requirements.
Only disable this setting if you are running a mod that bypasses server password requirements, and you would like VSG to stop validating passwords as well.

data.value: These paths are used for all profiles. You can override these paths for individual profiles in the Advanced Controls tab.

data.name: KnownCharacters_Help
data.value:
The Valheim character names that this player is known by. Names are automatically added to this list when a player joins the server, but you may modify them manually.
If a name appears with a (!), it means that name may not be matched to the correct player (due to a Valheim server limitation). You may remove this name if it's incorrect, or select the name and click Confirm to remove the warning.

data.name: AddPlayer_SetAsDefault_Help

data.name: WorldPreferences_Preset_Help
data.value:
Presets are quick sets of options to help you get a server up and running quickly.
If you select a preset and change any individual settings, then the preset will be deselected.

data.name: WorldPreferences_WikiPrefix
data.value: Read more about world modifiers on the

data.name: WorldPreferences_NotWorking
data.value: Modifiers not working like you expected? You may already have modifiers set in-game.

data.name: WorldGen_Combat_Help
data.value: Governs how much damage you give and take. Also governs how likely you are to encounter higher leveled enemies, and how dangerous they are.

data.name: WorldGen_DeathPenalty_Help
data.value: Governs what happens when you die. See the wiki for an explanation of the different options.

data.name: WorldGen_Resources_Help
data.value: Governs the amount of resources you gain from the world and from enemies.

data.name: WorldGen_Raids_Help
data.value: Governs how often enemies may raid your base.

data.name: WorldGen_Portals_Help
data.value: Changes how portals work in the game.

data.name: WorldGen_NoBuildCost_Help
data.value: Build pieces require no materials to build. You still need to discover recipes as per usual.

data.name: WorldGen_PlayerEvents_Help
data.value: Raids are based on the progress of each individual player, rather than on which bosses have been killed on the server. This setting is recommended if you want the game to be slightly friendlier to players with different progress.

data.name: WorldGen_PassiveMobs_Help
data.value: Enemies won't attack until you provoke them.

data.name: WorldGen_NoMap_Help
data.value: You will not have access to the map or the minimap. This makes the game harder than intended.

data.name: WorldGen_Fire_Help
data.value: Wood can catch fire and spread throughout the whole world, not just in the Ashlands.

data.name: BugReport_Intro
data.value: Describe the problem. A crash report with your app/OS details and recent logs is included.

data.name: BugReport_Description_Help
data.value:
Describe the bug you're experiencing in detail, including: - A detailed description of the problem you're experiencing - Any steps required to reproduce the bug
Your bug report will be submitted alongside some details about your computer, which version you're running, etc. to help us further troubleshoot the problem. No personal or identifying details about your computer will be collected.

data.name: BugReport_Contact_Help
data.value:
If you'd like, supply your email address, Twitter handle, or any other way we can contact you in case we need more information to follow up on your bug report.
Of course, we will never share this information with any third parties. (I don't even know how to do that)
